
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/FanGuo123/p/23568716" title="发布于 2026-11-06 21:53">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">如何在汇川AUTOSHOP中作为客户端实现 TCP 协议</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p><strong>一、实验环境</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>
<p>AUTOSHOP小型机编程软件</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3743732/202611/3743732-20261106054620588-1780601495.png" class="lazyload"><br>
2.新建一个项目，设备选择汇川小型机easy系列easy523<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3743732/202611/3743732-20261106054752712-1811562566.png" class="lazyload"><br>
3.tcp协议测试工具netassistant<br>
<img alt="屏幕截图 2026-11-06 203222" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3743732/202611/3743732-20261106203225938-379063274.png" class="lazyload"><br>
网页下载链接：<a href="https://netassistant.trydo.top/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"></a></p>
</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>二、当easy523做 TCP 客户端Client</strong><br>
1.建立TCP通讯客户端连接，拖出“TCP_Connect”功能块，作为TCP通讯客户端<br>
用M8013作为触发连接信号，每1s周期进行TCP连接，防止断链。<strong>Socket</strong>接口填入一个20个int数组，<strong>IPAddress</strong>填入ip类型数据，<strong>port</strong>参数为int类型，需要和服            务器保持一致。<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3743732/202611/3743732-20261106210815311-745083199.png" class="lazyload"><br>
<strong>三、 进行数据的读取</strong><br>
1.在pcl程序中，拖出“TCP_Receive”功能块，进行TCP通讯数据读取<br>
创建触发信号<strong>bExTcpRead</strong>，<strong>Socket</strong>接口填入和“TCP_Connect”功能块中获取的Socket参数，<strong>Buffer</strong>接口为读取数据缓冲区可自定义数据长度但是必须为Int类型,<strong>Size</strong>接口的数据需与和缓存区长度一致。<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3743732/202611/3743732-20261106211657645-1854361129.png" class="lazyload"><br>
2.NetAssistant服务器端建立<br>
打开软件后，点击创建<strong>服务端连接</strong>。<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3743732/202611/3743732-20261106212943888-153693520.png" class="lazyload"><br>
因为在仿真测试，所有ip为127.0.0.1本地回环地址，端口和plc中填入的5000保持一致，选择TCP协议通讯。<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3743732/202611/3743732-20261106212803230-293131170.png" class="lazyload"><br>
3.读取测试<br>
PLC开启仿真，进行程序下载，可以库句柄已经获取有数值。<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3743732/202611/3743732-20261106213248987-2079686522.png" class="lazyload"><br>
NetAssistant中点击开始后，发一个字符串<strong>HELLO</strong>，现在去PLC侧进行读取触发看有没有数值。<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3743732/202611/3743732-20261106213406306-2033677315.png" class="lazyload"><br>
在仿真对触发信号<strong>bExTcpRead</strong>写入为“ON”后，可以看到读取缓存区中有数据。<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3743732/202611/3743732-20261106213754481-774670479.png" class="lazyload"><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3743732/202611/3743732-20261106213850941-1443227550.png" class="lazyload"><br>
<strong>四、 进行数据的发送</strong><br>
1.在pcl程序中，拖出“TCP_Send”功能块，进行TCP通讯数据发送<br>
创建触发信号<strong>bExTcpSend</strong>，<strong>Socket</strong>接口填入和“TCP_Connect”功能块中获取的Socket参数，<strong>Buffer</strong>接口为读取数据缓冲区可自定义数据长度但是必须为Int类型,<strong>Size</strong>接口的数据需与和缓存区长度一致。<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3743732/202611/3743732-20261106214551677-700159102.png" class="lazyload"><br>
2.发送测试<br>
向数据缓存区内写入“HELLO”转换的Int16数值如图。<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3743732/202611/3743732-20261106214659413-283962532.png" class="lazyload"><br>
在仿真对触发信号<strong>bExTcpSend</strong>写入为“ON”后，可以看到NetAssistant中有"HELLO"。<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3743732/202611/3743732-20261106214945452-1875763646.png" class="lazyload"><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3743732/202611/3743732-20261106215006858-32367387.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
